items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: after the Cotton Club the next group would come in, Duke Ellington and Ethel Waters would be next

ctx.x: One Sweet [Unintelligible], all those great things. So that was the era. Traveling is what I want to get back to. We had six months in the Cotton Club, then we started… after the Cotton Club the next group would come in, Duke Ellington and Ethel Waters would be next, something like that. And we would start on theaters, theater tunes. We got a chorus girl, he‟s got dancers and…
